findings.SOURCE_RUN: integrate_r3_v3:baseline_1 and baseline_2 validate win/loss and costs
findings.OBSERVATION: baseline_1_momentum_5m_sign_v1 validate reports winning_closed_trades=7 and losing_closed_trades=182; baseline_2_mean_reversion_5m_sign_v1 reports 60 wins and 126 losses. estimated_costs≈63.71 apply on traded_notional≈127412 despite small gross magnitudes (-90.46 and -5.07), yielding net_pnl more negative than gross for both.
findings.LIMITATION: Cost model is research notional-linear-bps/1.0.0; not broker-fee calibrated.
findings.POSSIBLE_CAUSE: Linear bps charges scale with turnover/notional independent of per-trade win rate.
findings.REQUIRED_DATA: Pre-registered bps grid and fill-price realism audit in a NEW experiment_id.
findings.PROPOSED_TEST: Sensitivity run varying cost_model bps only with locked strategies and splits; primary metric net_pnl dispersion vs bps.

findings.OBSERVATION: Mean-reversion baseline shows higher directional_accuracy (≈0.527) than momentum (≈0.463) on the same validate split, yet both report negative gross and net PnL under v3 economics (net≈-68.78 vs -154.17).
findings.LIMITATION: Directional accuracy is label alignment, not economic edge; five sessions only.
findings.POSSIBLE_CAUSE: Sign prediction quality decouples from simulated fill prices, exposure, and cost drag on this harness.
findings.REQUIRED_DATA: Per-fill mark policy and bar conservative fill audit trail in a new bounded experiment.
findings.PROPOSED_TEST: Compare forward-return sign metrics vs gross_pnl per baseline without selecting a winner on v3 receipts.

findings.LIMITATION: Small validate sample_count=148; volume gate behavior not ablated in v3.
findings.POSSIBLE_CAUSE: relative_volume_10m>=1.0 gate reduces intents/fills and increases concurrent exposure versus always-on momentum.
findings.REQUIRED_DATA: Pre-registered threshold grid on OpenD pin in NEW experiment.
findings.PROPOSED_TEST: Defer to ranked Lane H queue entry; no in-place v3 parameter edits.
